title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 SEP)
summary: A collection of feature ideas and improvement suggestions submitted by the Business Central community for the platform across multiple areas including data migration, development, financial management, inventory, manufacturing, and more. The post catalogs user-requested enhancements that could address gaps in existing functionality.
key_points: Community members submitted ideas across 15+ functional areas from data migration to warehouse management
Development improvements include MCP server for compiler, integration events, index rebuild procedures, and security enhancements
Financial management ideas focus on VAT handling, currency translations, deferral templates, and localization features
Inventory and manufacturing suggestions address lot blocking, backflushing, ABC classification, and variant attributes
General platform improvements requested include clipboard functions, universal search, tooltips for enums, and workflow enhancements
